# Repository context

Local-first Apple Silicon assistant: German chat/voice, Node.js 24, SQLite, Electron, SwiftUI. Main code: Projektdateien/alfred-v0.3 and Projektdateien/ALFRED-Apps. Documentation and review feedback should be English; application UI remains German.

Never request or commit private chats, pairing tokens, or credentials. Preserve localhost defaults, exact certificate pinning, and deliberate memory controls. No command execution from model output or global ATS exceptions.

Read the existing code and Pipecat/Piper integration before proposing changes. Libraries alone do not establish better answers. Provide relevant tests and measured evidence; do not invent performance or listening results. Attribute third-party source and retain its license. Prefer small PRs with concrete before/after behavior.
